stress.title: Stress it
stress.desc: How much does this model take if the data shifts a little? The same model, without retraining it, is measured on the test that was already opened: with noise in the numbers, with one column shuffled and with a drift. It chooses and changes nothing.
stress.error: The model could not be stressed. Try again.
stress.need-test: An imported model does not carry the test it was measured on: stress it in the run where you trained it.
stress.not-applicable: Clustering has no target and no test: there is nothing to stress.
stress.no-numeric: This model uses no numeric columns: there is nowhere to put noise or drift. Below, what happens when each column is shuffled.
stress.base: Unperturbed: {metric} {value}, measured on the {n} rows of the test.

worse.higher: With {pct} % noise in the numbers, your {metric} falls from {from} to {to}.
worse.lower: With {pct} % noise in the numbers, your {metric} rises from {from} to {to}.

line.same: With {pct} % noise in the numbers, your {metric} barely moves: from {from} to {to}.
line.better: With {pct} % noise in the numbers, your {metric} does not get worse (from {from} to {to}); that is chance in the test, not an improvement.

noise.title: Noise in the numbers
noise.desc: Noise is added to every numeric column, in proportion to how much it varies in training.

shuffle.title: One column shuffled
shuffle.desc: The values of one column are shuffled at a time: what the model loses is how much it relied on it. Here, the {count} that hurt most.
shuffle.desc_one: The values of one column are shuffled at a time: what the model loses is how much it relied on it. Here, the one that hurts most.
shuffle.more: {count} other columns hurt less than these.
shuffle.more_one: One other column hurts less than these.

shift.title: A drift, like the passing of time
shift.desc: The numeric columns that weigh most are moved up, as if their values were different with time: {columns}.

seal.holds: ✓ With {pct} % noise it still beats its best rival without a model: {value} against {rival}.
seal.drops: ⚠ With {pct} % noise it stops beating its best rival without a model: {value} against {rival}.
seal.already-lost: ⚠ Before the noise it already did not beat its best rival without a model ({base} against {rival}): noise is not the cause.
seal.no-noise: With no numeric columns, noise is not judged.
seal.caveat: This is a reading of this test, not a guarantee: other data may give another figure. The seed is fixed ({seed}): repeating it gives the same.

stage8.note: It is optional and not a new opening: it uses the same test, with the same seal and the same winner, and chooses nothing. If you run it before registering the stage, its figure at 10 % noise and the rival without a model go into the notebook and the sheet.
stage8.saved: This reading is saved with stage 8 when you register it.
stage8.reopen: If you open the test again, the reading is lost and has to be requested again.
